_comment: Source of truth for https://dchub.cloud/mcp/directories (lib/directories-page.mjs). Only status 'live' renders; 'pending' and 'unverified' stay hidden. Grok's hourly presence routine edits this file when a listing goes live or drifts: set status, listing_url (https only), optional badge_url (an image the directory serves), and verified_at. No prices or facility counts anywhere in this file.
